This is a handwritten, bounded extraction of read-only live2 `catalog-c1.json` (Light and ValueField<float>) and `catalog-c7.json` (AudioDeviceIndexFinder and string). Only the named fields are retained, so owner membersComplete is false. Original owner inheritance, generic flags and incomplete closure are retained. Scalar representations are reclassified according to mapper 3; no acquisition or runtime mutation is implied. The declaration is independently handwritten and compared byte-for-byte to C# generation; the JSX compiler tests consume this same declaration.
